name: Sensor Top Bar
author: izicubed
description: A modern flat-design top bar shown on every page that displays live telemetry from installed sensors: battery voltage and charge %, Raspberry Pi core temperature, outside temperature, pressure, humidity, current and more. Also shows live host load - CPU usage, RAM usage and free disk space on Linux and Windows. Battery percentage is computed from a configurable cell count, per-cell voltage range and pack capacity (mAh), with Windows host-battery fallback. Includes a demo mode so the bar can be exercised on a PC with no hardware attached. Dark, light and auto (follow browser/OS) colour themes.
